_comment: Hand and review-pass corrections for tools/generate_deck_tagalog.py. _drop removes a word; other keys override gloss/gloss/pos/posName for that word.

_drop_reasons.kang: enclitic fragment (ka + linker); gloss is wrong
_drop_reasons.taong: linker form of tao/taon; gloss is wrong
_drop_reasons.ilang: linker form of ilan (a few); the 'desert' sense does not match usage
_drop_reasons.mag-post: English word (post) with a Filipino verb prefix; sentences unrelated
_drop_reasons.magigi: obscure; sentences use magiging, a different word
_drop_reasons.tayong: linker form of tayo, not a headword
_drop_reasons.silang: linker form of sila, not a headword
_drop_reasons.piging: obscure (piging); sentences are about nagiging/maging, so rank is a stemmer artefact
_drop_reasons.nami: obscure plant (yam); sentences are about 'naming' (our), a stemmer artefact
_drop_reasons.pong: particle fragment (po + linker -ng), not a headword
_drop_reasons.tuna: frequency inflated by natutunan; not a core word
_drop_reasons.lala: obscure bare root; sentences use kilala
_drop_reasons.van: English/Dutch name element (van Gogh), not a Tagalog word
